ns2:section.sectionText: Seminar presentations by Food Science and Human Nutrition faculty. Presentations will focus on specialized research topics and current literature relating to faculty research interests and potential collaborations. Two speakers will present each week. Center for Innovation in Teaching & Learning (CITL) restrictions and assessments apply, see http://www.citl.illinois.edu. Online scheduled class sessions require each student to have high speed internet access and either a headset with microphone or an external microphone and speakers so they may participate in the class discussions. Wireless internet is not recommended.
ns2:section.sectionNotes: Restricted to MS: FSHN (Online) -UIUC, MS:FSci &Hmn Nutrition -UIUC, or NDEG:Grad Nondegree-CE-UIUC.
ns2:section.sectionFeeAmount: Graduate - Urbana-Champaign OCE Tuition $387.00 per Bill Hour, Undergrad - Urbana-Champaign OCE Tuition $353.00 per Bill Hour, and OCE Fees $50.00 per Bill Hour.
